scripts.sync:content: npm run sync:gitbook && npm run sync:external
scripts.build: npm run sync:content && astro build && npm run export:markdown
scripts.export:markdown: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.accessSync('src/content/docs/index.md'); fs.rmSync('dist/markdown', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('src/content/docs', 'dist/markdown', { recursive: true });"
